name: BMA Lite – Appointment Booking and Scheduling
author: RedefiningTheWeb

sections.description:
BMA Lite is a free WordPress booking plugin for appointment-based businesses. It adds an online booking form to your site and an appointment scheduler to your dashboard, with services, staff working hours, customers, an appointment list and a calendar. There is no trial period and no limit on services, staff or bookings.

A client picks a service, a specialist, a date and a time, enters their contact details, and pays at the appointment. The booking arrives as pending, and you approve it in WordPress.

Lite does not take online payments, send booking emails or SMS, stop two clients booking the same time, or connect to Google Calendar. It is not built for hotel rooms, rentals, event tickets or staff shift rotas.

Who it suits

Any business where a client books time with a particular person:

  • Medical and therapy practices: a patient books a visit or consultation with a doctor, dentist, physiotherapist or therapist, and each one keeps their own hours and breaks.
  • Salons and barbers: a customer chooses a treatment and a stylist at a hair salon, barbershop or spa.
  • Tutors and teachers: a student books a lesson or tutoring session with a named tutor, alone or in a group.

What your clients see

  • A five-step form: service, specialist, date and time, their details, and payment. It fits phone screens.
  • Services with name, image and price, then only the specialists who offer the chosen one.
  • Times every 30 minutes on the days the specialist works, with the whole appointment inside their hours and clear of their breaks.
  • Booking from the next day on. Closed days and holidays cannot be chosen.
  • A server check of each booking against what the form offers; if it does not match, the form says why.
  • A WordPress account for new clients, with an emailed link to set a password. [rtwbmal_cus_login_page] lets them see their appointments, cancel those on a later day and edit their profile; [rtwbma_cus_register_page] adds registration if “Anyone can register” is on.

What you manage in WordPress

  • Services: categories, image, price, duration and the number of people allowed per booking.
  • Staff scheduling: each specialist’s photo, contact details, services, weekly working hours and breaks. Unticking “Visible to Public” takes someone off the form and keeps their bookings.
  • Appointments: filter by dates, service, employee, customer and status; add or change them, with status, payment status, amount paid and a note.
  • Calendar: month, week, day or list view.
  • Customers and payments: lists in pages, with each booking’s price and amount paid.
  • Locations: addresses and who works at each; the form does not ask clients to choose one.
  • Settings: business hours, holidays and currency.

BMA Lite and BMA Pro

Everything above works without Pro. BMA Pro is a separate paid plugin on CodeCanyon that needs BMA Lite to stay active. It adds:

  • Seven booking-form designs, with a shortcode for each saved form.
  • PayPal and Stripe payments, and coupons.
  • Email and SMS notifications, with texts sent through your own Twilio or MSG91 account.
  • Google Calendar: bookings go to a calendar you connect. Changes in Google do not edit BMA bookings.
  • Booking questions, a choice of location, a dashboard with charts and an employee page for managing bookings.

External services

BMA Lite uses one external service, Google Fonts: the booking form and the account page use the Nunito Sans font, which the visitor’s browser downloads from fonts.gstatic.com unless the device has it. Google receives the visitor’s IP address and standard request headers; no booking details are sent. See the Google Fonts privacy FAQ, the Google Privacy Policy and the Google APIs Terms of Service.

Lite connects to no other service.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New Plugin, search for “BMA Lite”, click Install Now, then Activate.
  2. Open “Book My Appointment Lite” in the admin menu.
  3. Under Settings, set your business hours, holidays and currency. Unticked days are closed; each specialist’s hours set the times.
  4. Under Services, add a category and your services with their price and duration.
  5. Under Employees, add your specialists, choose their services and set their working hours and breaks.
  6. Add a Shortcode block with [BookMyAppointmentForm] to a page and publish it.
  7. Make a test booking in a private browser window; it appears under Appointments as pending.

If you also use BMA Pro, activate BMA Lite first, then Pro.
sections.faq:
How do I add appointment booking to my WordPress site?

Install BMA Lite, add a service and a specialist who offers it, then put [BookMyAppointmentForm] on a page. It is a shortcode, so it goes in a Shortcode block or any page-builder element that runs shortcodes; there is no dedicated block or Elementor widget.

Is BMA Lite free? Are there limits or booking fees?

It is free, with no trial, no booking fees and no outside account: it runs on your own WordPress site. Categories, services, specialists, locations, customers and appointments have no limit.

Can clients pay online?

Not with Lite. Bookings are recorded with “Pay Locally”, and you note the payment status and amount on the appointment. BMA Pro adds PayPal and Stripe.

Does it send booking emails or SMS reminders?

No. The only emails are WordPress’s own: when a booking, or an employee or customer you add, creates an account, WordPress emails that person a password link and notifies the administrator.

Can two clients book the same time?

Yes. Lite checks that a time is one the form offers but does not compare it with bookings already made. New bookings arrive as pending, so check the calendar before you approve them.

Does it work with Google Calendar?

Not in Lite. BMA Pro sends bookings to a calendar you connect.

Can a clinic or doctor’s office use it?

Yes, for booking visits. It has no patient records, telehealth or reminders, and it makes no HIPAA or other compliance claim. Client details are stored in your WordPress database, so check what your rules require.

Can clients cancel or reschedule?

On the account page, clients can cancel appointments on a later day; you are not notified, so check the list. Only you can reschedule, by editing the appointment.

Why is a specialist or a time missing from the form?

A specialist appears when they offer the chosen service and are marked “Visible to Public”. A time appears when the day is not closed or a holiday, the specialist works that weekday, and the whole appointment fits their hours and breaks. Employees added in 1.4.4 were saved without hours: open each on the Employees screen and save it.

What happens when I delete a booking, customer or location?

Deleting an appointment also deletes its customer link and payment record; nothing is refunded. Deleting an employee, service, category or customer also deletes their bookings; a customer’s WordPress account stays. Deleting a location keeps its bookings.

Why do some screens say “available in Pro”?

Dashboard statistics, the Template, Appearance, Forms, Coupons and notification screens, and the Notifications, Payment Gateways and Google Calendar settings are previews of BMA Pro. They have no effect in Lite.

How do I move to BMA Pro?

Keep BMA Lite active, then install and activate Pro and enter your purchase code. Both use the same tables, so your data stays. While Pro is active, Lite does not run its own screens or form.

What does BMA Lite store about clients?

Name, email, phone number and message, the appointment and its payment record, in the plugin’s own tables, plus a WordPress account for new clients. Lite does not add them to WordPress’s personal-data export and erase tools. Deleting the plugin keeps the tables.

Where can I get help?

Ask in the support forum.
sections.changelog:
1.4.6

  • An update no longer reopens a site whose weekdays are all closed. The Lite screens say so instead.
  • Booking form: centred radios, tappable rows, step menu on phones, Prev and Next in one row, readable colours, a keyboard path. Styles stay out of your theme.
  • Account page and admin screens fit a phone.

1.4.5

  • Security fixes, a repaired booking form with a server check of each booking, and no limits.
  • Business Hours shows its days and times, and a save no longer closes every day.

Full list and earlier versions: see changelog.txt.
